text.p: The first by-election under Australia's new conservative government will be held on October 19, acting lower house speaker Gary Nehl said on Monday.

The High Court last week ordered a fresh election for the Sydney-based lower house seat of Lindsay after it found government backbencher Jackie Kelly had been ineligible to stand when she won the seat from Labor in the March 2 election.
Lindsay was one of several seats taken from Labor by the Liberal-National coalition in its landslide March 2 election win which ended 13 years of Labor rule.
Nominations for the seat close on Friday, September 27, and the electoral rolls close on Monday, September 23, Nehl said in a statement.
Kelly was found ineligible because shestill received money from the government, as an airforce member, and retained New Zealand citizenship, both of which contravene the constitution.
